summary: Eikon Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing an updated corporate presentation and press release regarding clinical trial data presentations at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine disclosure of operational updates under Items 7.01 and 8.01, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are discussed. The filing is not a special situation.
